status: documented constraints; no deck validator in Phase 1

deck_constraints.signature_exception: Same Bakugan in different attributes may each have one Signature Ability.
deck_constraints.fusion_prerequisite: A Fusion Ability requires prior use of its specific Signature Ability.

rules.text: Generic and Guardian; a Guardian is optional and limited to one per deck.
Four subtypes: Signature, Normal, Fusion, and Trap. Fusion does not use an Ability Slot.
Four types: Attribute, Reactor, Command, and Character.
Preyas can change his attribute once per turn while on the field to Aquos, Darkus, or Subterra.
Always considered as both attributes; may activate either attribute’s Abilities.
Three Bakugan, three Gates, six Abilities; no duplicate card names, no duplicate Bakugan in the same attribute, at most one Guardian, and at least one Attribute or Reactor Gate.

notes: Image-only G-Power charts require separate visual transcription; individual base G-Power remains unknown in bakugan.json.
Deck validator deferred to a later phase.
